id: 21_Replace the Motherboard for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊机：更换主板
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/21_Replace the Motherboard for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/21_Replace the Motherboard for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K6: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
points.K7: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
points.K8: 装新主板，插头插回原位

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带脚轮的激光焊接机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine in a workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换主控板。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换主控板

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：把手、侧盖、电路板、挂钩
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a machine handle, a side cover, a circuit board and a small hook. No people.
shots.narration: 拆把手、开左盖、换主板、装回。

shots.scene: 焊接机屏幕不亮，阿杰皱眉看着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a laser welding machine whose screen stays dark.
shots.narration: 焊接机的主板坏了，需要更换。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱和一块新电路板走来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer comes over carrying a toolbox and a new circuit board.
shots.narration: 老李带着工具和新主板来了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们看看具体步骤。

shots.scene: 台面上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把内六角扳手、一把镊子
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a workbench with two cross-head screwdrivers of different sizes, a hex wrench and a pair of tweezers neatly laid out. No people.
shots.narration: 工具：5毫米和3毫米十字螺丝刀，

shots.scene: 工具旁放着一块新电路板
shots.prompt_en: A new circuit board lies next to the tools on the workbench. No people.
shots.narration: 5毫米内六角、镊子，还有新主板。

shots.scene: 老李按下焊接机开关，然后拔下电源插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the laser welding machine and pulls the power plug out of the wall socket.
shots.narration: 第一步：关机，

shots.scene: 老李把机器上的线缆依次拔下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer disconnects all the cables from the back of the machine one by one.
shots.narration: 拔掉所有线缆。

shots.scene: 老李蹲下，把机器底部的脚轮锁扣按下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer crouches and presses down the brake lever on a caster wheel under the machine.
shots.narration: 把机器底部四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 四个脚轮图标都带锁，机器稳稳停在地上
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a wheeled machine with all four casters showing small lock symbols, standing still. No people.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮都锁住，机器不会移动。

shots.scene: 机器侧面，把手两端的螺丝被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Side view of the laser welding machine with green circles marking the screws at both ends of the top handles. No people.
shots.narration: 用5毫米内六角，松开前后把手螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把松开的把手取下，放在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the loosened handle off the machine and places it on the bench.
shots.narration: 两个把手一共8颗螺丝，取下把手。

shots.scene: 老李用小号十字螺丝刀拧下侧盖顶部的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a small cross-head screwdriver to remove a screw at the top of the left side cover.
shots.narration: 用3毫米十字刀，拆下左盖的螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把左侧盖板向外取下，露出内部电路
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the left side cover away, revealing power modules, wiring and a circuit board inside.
shots.narration: 取下左侧盖板，就能看到主控板了。

shots.section_title: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 老李捏住插头本体，把它从主板上拔下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer grips a connector body and pulls it straight out of the circuit board.
shots.narration: 依次拔下主板上的所有插头。
overlay: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶

shots.section_title: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 老李用镊子轻轻剥掉插头上的固定胶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses tweezers to gently peel away a dab of glue holding a connector in place.
shots.narration: 插头上有固定胶的，先用镊子去胶。

shots.section_title: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
shots.scene: 主板特写，七个螺丝孔位被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the circuit board inside the machine with seven green circles marking its mounting screws. No people.
shots.narration: 主板由7颗螺丝固定在机架上。
overlay: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板

shots.section_title: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
shots.scene: 老李用大号十字螺丝刀逐颗拧下螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the board's mounting screws one by one with a larger cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 用5毫米十字刀，逐颗拆下。

shots.section_title: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
shots.scene: 老李徒手拿着旧主板取出，放到一旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the old circuit board out with bare hands and sets it aside on the bench.
shots.narration: 取出旧主板。

shots.section_title: 装新主板，插头插回原位
shots.scene: 老李把新主板对准螺丝孔放好
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lines up the new circuit board with the mounting holes inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 新主板对准孔位，放回原来的位置。
overlay: 装新主板，插头插回原位

shots.section_title: 装新主板，插头插回原位
shots.scene: 老李拧上七颗螺丝固定新主板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens the new board with its seven screws using the cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拧上7颗螺丝，固定牢靠。

shots.section_title: 装新主板，插头插回原位
shots.scene: 老李把插头逐个插回原来的插座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs each connector back into its original socket on the new board.
shots.narration: 插头逐个插回原位，插到底。

shots.scene: 老李把机器下方垂落的线缆理顺，收回机内
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gathers the loose cables hanging below the open side and tucks them neatly inside.
shots.narration: 整理好左侧的线缆，收回机内。

shots.scene: 整齐的线束图标打勾，被盖板压住的线图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a neat cable bundle with a green check mark, and a cable pinched under a cover edge with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆不能被盖板压住。

shots.scene: 盖板边缘的挂钩和机架上的销钉，用箭头对应
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the side cover edge with three hooks and the machine frame with three pegs, arrows matching each hook to a peg. No people.
shots.narration: 左盖两侧有三个挂钩，对准三个销钉。

shots.scene: 老李把盖板推入机器，再拧紧顶部螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the side cover into place and tightens the screw at its top.
shots.narration: 把盖板推进去，再拧紧螺丝固定。

shots.scene: 老李把把手放回原位，用内六角扳手拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets a handle back on top of the machine and tightens its screws with the hex wrench.
shots.narration: 最后装回把手，拧紧螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李走到另一侧，同样装好把手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the other side of the machine and fits the second handle the same way.
shots.narration: 另一侧也一样，用4颗螺丝固定。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接机旁，身后浮现几个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the closed laser welding machine with a row of step icons floating behind: a plug, a handle, a circuit board and a side cover.
shots.narration: 关机拔线锁脚轮，拆把手和左盖。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 有胶先去胶，7颗螺丝，插头回原位。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰在焊接机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 主板换好了，下次见！
